why: Confirm on a focused CONTAINER must land focus on the first control, not activate it -- the half of issue #919's ruling that stays: a pane with no primary action arrives on its container, and focus can fall back to one, and a gamepad Confirm there would otherwise fire whatever happens to be first (New Game, on a Main Menu with no run).
killedBy: hud: the semantic action dispatcher (issue #494) confirm on a focused container lands on the first control instead of activating it; confirm on the arrival's primary activates it once
